verdict.rationale: As a GPU, the RTX 5080 can plausibly be used for headless compute. NVIDIA documents its own CUDA Toolkit runtime and compilers, plus CUDA containers distributed via NGC, which point toward containerized, non-interactive GPU workloads. None of the evidence explicitly mentions headless operation, CI integration, or support for this GeForce card in server or CI contexts. Missing for 10: explicit headless/no-display operation docs, CI pipeline integration guidance, confirmation that NGC containers support GeForce RTX 5080, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of automated/CI use.
